Emerick  Washn Apl 29th 1865
for Bennet zebra Nabob need not accompany his panama
across the country but may return here by water
with his staff peru he sees his panama started
unity All his silver escort wagons & ambulances had
better pocket the country zodiac shading off the country
and all destruction of property I hope wilby avoided

every plug to lay down their nuisance on the same
